name: Warper
description: Teleports players to any town, field or dungeon, and to the last place they warped.

name: Job Master
description: Changes jobs on the spot, from Novice up, without the job quests.

name: Platinum skills
description: Gives every class its quest skills, without the quests.

name: Healer
description: Heals HP and SP for free and gives Blessing and Increase Agility.

name: Universal Rental
description: Hands out a cart, falcon, Peco Peco, dragon, warg or Mado Gear in one click, whichever the class can use.

name: Card Seller
description: Sells every card monsters drop, except MVP cards.
unavailable: Needs rAthena's item and monster databases in SQL, which this server doesn't fill, so it would sell nothing.

name: Shop Street
description: A street of shops in north Prontera selling weapons, armour and accessories for zeny.

name: Stylist
description: Changes hair style, hair colour and clothes colour.

name: Reset Girl
description: Resets skills, stats or both for zeny.

name: Card Remover
description: Takes cards out of equipment for zeny, with a chance to break the item or the cards.

name: Item Signer
description: Writes the player's name on a weapon or armour.

name: WoE Controller
description: Lets GMs set the War of Emperium schedule in game instead of in a script.

name: Private MVP room
description: Rents a room for a player, party or guild to summon MVPs in.

name: MVP Arena
description: Rooms with 16 different MVPs to fight.

name: Penal Servitude
description: A jail quest: prisoners work off their sentence by collecting items.

name: Kafra bank
description: A Kafra that keeps a character's zeny and pays daily interest.

name: Banker
description: Keeps zeny for the whole account, so all its characters share it.

name: Lottery
description: A daily lottery draw players buy tickets for.

name: Stock market
description: A stock market game played with zeny.
warning: A GM has to talk to the NPC to open the market before players can use it.

name: Russian Roulette
description: Russian Roulette mixed with Rock, Scissors, Paper.
warning: Its prizes include Old Blue, Violet and Card Albums.

name: Black Jack
description: Casino Black Jack against the dealer.

name: Shifty Assassin
description: Players hire ninja squads to attack another player.

name: Monster Arena
description: Players train monsters and fight other players' monsters with them.

name: Morocc raceway
description: A race around Morocc, with a prize for the winner.

name: Floating rates
description: Changes the exp and drop rates at random between 1x and 1.5x every 6 hours.
warning: It replaces the rates set in Battle config while it runs.

name: Wedding
description: Weddings for any two players, including same-sex marriages.

name: Quest warper
description: A warper that only goes to places the player has already been to.

name: Auto-potion
description: Adds an @autopot command that uses a potion when HP drops below a set level.

name: Airship
description: An unofficial airship route between the main towns, as on elRO.

name: Hunting missions
description: Random monster hunting missions, with rewards by difficulty.
unavailable: Needs rAthena's monster database in SQL, which this server doesn't fill, so it can't pick monsters.

name: Quest shop
description: Trades items for other items. Comes with a sample list; copy the script into a mod to set your own.

name: Questboard
description: Collection and hunting quests from a board. Comes with sample quests; copy the script into a mod to set your own.

name: Treasure Hunters Guild
description: 40 quests for the Treasure Hunters Guild, with its own shop.

name: Elven Ears
description: A quest for Elven Ears, from base level 75.

name: Slotted Sunglasses
description: A quest for slotted Sunglasses.

name: Bandit Beard
description: A quest for the Bandit Beard headgear.

name: Six new hats
description: Four brothers' quests for six headgears the official quests leave out.

name: May hats
description: Quests for headgears from an RO mobile game event.

name: King's items
description: Quests for the Grand Circlet and Excalibur.

name: Dead Branch
description: Trades logs and wood for Dead Branches.

name: Berzebub Card
description: A quest for the Berzebub Card.

name: Jewel Case
description: A quest for a Jewel Case, at base level 99.

name: Valhalla equipment
description: Quests for Mjolnir, Sleipnir, Brisingamen, Gleipnir and Megingjard.
warning: These are godly items, and the quests are easier than the official ones.

name: Balmung and Kaho's Horns
description: Quests for Balmung and Lord Kaho's Horns.
warning: Godly items, and the quests are very easy.

name: Lord Kaho's Horns
description: A quest for Lord Kaho's Horns.
warning: A godly item. Balmung and Kaho's Horns has its own Kaho's Horns quest; use one or the other.

name: Thanatos Tower statues
description: An unofficial quest with the statues in Thanatos Tower.

name: Sphinx Mask
description: A quest for the Sphinx Mask, once part of the Umbala quests.

name: Umbalian language
description: Learning the Umbalian language, once part of the Umbala quests.

name: Cluckers
description: Click the chicken for a small chance at a prize; miss and it freezes, stuns or blows you up.

name: Devil Square
description: Three waves of monsters for treasure, as in MU Online.

name: Disguise event
description: A GM-run game: guess the monster the NPC is disguised as for a prize.

name: Find the Mushroom
description: Mushrooms spawn on random maps; players who find and kill them win prizes.

name: MVP ladder
description: A party kills every MVP in turn, from weakest to strongest.

name: Christmas rings
description: A Christmas and New Year event, from 8 December to 8 January.

name: Valentine's Day
description: Valentine's chocolate, with an exp bonus for married players.

name: Halloween
description: A Halloween trick-or-treat event.

name: Uneasy Cemetery
description: Every midnight a wave of undead attacks Prontera, and players defend it.

name: Emperium battleground
description: Two teams; destroy the other team's Emperium to win.

name: Team PvP battleground
description: Two teams; kill the other team's players to win.

name: Geffen Magic Tournament
description: The Geffen Magic Tournament dungeon, an unofficial version of kRO's. Earns coins to trade for rewards.
